The '''Crescent Canyon Facility''' was a research facility established decades before the [[Galactic War]] by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] to explore mining opportunities on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Constructed atop the [[Crescent Canyon Mesa]], the facility included a [[Crescent Canyon Monitoring Station|monitoring station]], [[Crescent Canyon Research Station|research station]], [[Crescent Canyon Laboratory|laboratory]], and additional facilities. It was eventually abandoned by Czerka but occupied by [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] colonists, and was later conquered by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
